headline: Kai, it all comes down to tonight — Nvidia reports its first quarter without Jensen Huang, into a tape already three days deep in a sell-off.
subline: October retail sales land at 8:30, markets call a December hike near-certain, and Anthropic's record IPO prices into Thursday.
asof: Pre-market · index values are futures · ≈6:45 AM ET Tue · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Nvidia reports tonight, minus the man who built it
items.sentence: Analysts look for $109.10 billion in quarterly revenue after Monday's 4.1% slide, per STL.News, in the first report since Jensen Huang resigned and CFO Colette Kress stepped in as interim chief.

items.title: Retail sales at 8:30; Home Depot, Disney this morning
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance pegs October retail sales consensus at +0.2% headline and +0.4% ex-autos, with Home Depot and Disney due before the open.

items.title: Markets now call a December hike near-certain
items.sentence: CME FedWatch puts the odds of a quarter-point hike at the December meeting at 93.5%, per Pintu Academy, with October producer prices up 6.5% from a year earlier.

items.title: Three straight down days, led by the AI trade
items.sentence: The S&P 500 lost 1.92% and the Nasdaq 2.49% Monday — its worst day since Nov. 5 — as investors kept selling AI names into the print, per TipRanks.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $1.07 billion in a week
items.sentence: Spot bitcoin funds logged $1.07 billion of net outflows in the week to Nov. 13, per Pintu Academy, with the coin down about 13% over seven days and sentiment reading 'extreme fear.'

items.title: Trump heads for a Xi–Putin trilateral in Shenzhen
items.sentence: Al Jazeera reports Trump meets Quad leaders in Manila before an APEC sit-down with Xi and Putin covering nuclear arms, Ukraine and Iran.

items.title: Ukraine hits the Kerch Bridge in mass drone attack
items.sentence: Explosions halted traffic on the bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea during one of the war's larger overnight drone barrages, per the Kyiv Post.

items.title: Houthis take the Bab al-Mandab chokepoint
items.sentence: Yemeni government forces pulled back to defend Aden, leaving the Red Sea strait in Houthi hands, per a Reuters report carried by the Cyprus Mail.

items.title: Vance: Iran war won't drag on, as carriers mass
items.sentence: He spoke as a third US carrier reached the region and a poll found 71% of Americans want Congress to legislate an end to the conflict, per 10 Things News.

items.title: Deutsche Bank slides on leaked Epstein payment files
items.sentence: Shares fell nearly 5% at the European open after leaked documents reportedly showed about $582 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein, per TipRanks.

items.title: Anthropic prices Thursday at up to $1.4 trillion
items.sentence: CNBC's guide puts the range at $70 to $78 a share ahead of Thursday's debut, which at the top would value the lab near $1.4 trillion.

items.title: Washington tightens AI-chip limits; Asia tech slumps
items.sentence: Asia-Pacific markets closed lower after the US tightened AI chip restrictions on China, per TipRanks, with the Hang Seng down 1.03% and the Nikkei off 1.34%.

items.title: Warsh opens the Fed's AI task force hearings
items.sentence: The Fed chair framed the central bank's role on AI's growth and jobs effects as 'neither advocacy nor opposition,' per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: 128 countries debate binding limits on autonomous weapons
items.sentence: At least 50 nations in Geneva back a timetable for binding rules on weapons that select targets without human sign-off, while the US, Russia and Israel oppose them, per 10 Things News.
